quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Too many separate demands landing at once, to the point of not being able to move, points to a specific state.
quests.explanation: Being unable to act because too many things are demanding attention at once is the core of feeling overwhelmed.
quests.textToSpeak: Between the move, the new job starting Monday, and my mother's appointment I still haven't scheduled, I sat in the driveway for ten minutes before I could make myself go inside.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A gesture that clearly cost the giver more than it should have points to a deep, quiet feeling.
quests.explanation: A gift that clearly came at real personal cost to the giver is what being touched really feels like.
quests.textToSpeak: My students pooled their own money, without telling me, to buy a gift for my last day. Most of them can barely afford lunch as it is.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Two things you genuinely want pulling in opposite directions points to a specific, torn feeling.
quests.explanation: Wanting two incompatible things equally, with no clean choice available, is exactly what conflicted feels like.
quests.textToSpeak: The job offer is everything I said I wanted five years ago. Taking it means missing my daughter's last year at home before college.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Fixating on one small, ambiguous word long after the conversation has moved on points to a restless unease.
quests.explanation: Replaying one ambiguous word from a conversation, long after it ended, is a clear sign of anxiety.
quests.textToSpeak: The specialist used the word 'concerning' and then immediately moved on to scheduling, like it was nothing. I've replayed that ten-second exchange all week.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Resenting an unequal split of roles, even one you agreed to and understand, points to a complicated feeling.
quests.explanation: Resenting an unequal split of roles, even a reasonable one, is an honest and common form of jealousy.
quests.textToSpeak: My co-parent gets to be the fun one, the weekend trips, the treats. I'm the one with the homework and the bedtime. I know it's not a competition. It feels like one anyway.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Someone giving up something costly to themselves, purely so you wouldn't be alone, points to a deep feeling.
quests.explanation: Someone sacrificing something costly purely so you wouldn't face hard news alone is a deep cause of gratitude.
quests.textToSpeak: My sister took an unpaid day off work, the same day I found out, just so I wouldn't have to hear the diagnosis alone in a waiting room.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Knowing the right action while also knowing its cost to someone you owe a great deal to points to a torn feeling.
quests.explanation: Knowing the right thing to do while dreading its cost to someone you respect is a genuine, difficult conflict.
quests.textToSpeak: Reporting it is the right thing to do. It also ends the career of someone who taught me almost everything I know.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A sudden pile of demands with no clear place to even start points to a specific, flooded state.
quests.explanation: Facing a sudden pile of urgent demands with no clear starting point is a common cause of feeling overwhelmed.
quests.textToSpeak: The inbox hit four hundred unread while I was out for two days, and every single one apparently needs an answer by this afternoon.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Watching someone overcome a lifelong pattern, in a single difficult moment, brings a complicated, warm feeling.
quests.explanation: Watching someone overcome a genuinely difficult, lifelong pattern is a specific and meaningful pride.
quests.textToSpeak: My father, who never once said the word 'sorry' in fifty years that I can remember, apologized to my mother in front of all of us at dinner.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A small effort, made consistently by many people, just for you, points to a deep, quiet feeling.
quests.explanation: A small, consistent effort made by many people, purely for your comfort, is a quiet cause of being touched.
quests.textToSpeak: The whole ward learned to say my name properly, and only my name, over the three weeks I was there. It's a small thing. It undid me a little.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A claim contradicted by the seller's own recent, public information tends to raise a clear doubt.
quests.explanation: A claim contradicted by the seller's own recent information is a solid basis for skepticism.
quests.textToSpeak: The seller says the flat has 'no history of damp' the same month the building's own newsletter mentioned repairs to damp on that exact floor.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Physical closeness without the conversations that used to fill it points to a quiet, specific feeling.
quests.explanation: Sharing space without the conversation that used to fill it is a quiet loneliness inside a relationship.
quests.textToSpeak: My husband is right there on the sofa most evenings. We've both stopped bringing up the things that used to make us talk for hours.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Two paths, each genuinely reasonable, pulling you in opposite directions points to a torn feeling.
quests.explanation: Two genuinely reasonable paths pulling in opposite directions, with no clearly right answer, is a real conflict.
quests.textToSpeak: Staying means finally getting the stability I've wanted for years. Leaving means not giving up on something I still believe could work.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Someone with less experience reaching the right answer far faster than a whole team points to admiration.
quests.explanation: Someone less experienced reaching the right answer faster than a whole established team is genuinely impressive.
quests.textToSpeak: The new resident diagnosed something in four minutes that had taken the rest of us three separate appointments to even suspect.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Multiple urgent things happening at once, with no clear priority, points to a flooded, specific state.
quests.explanation: Facing several urgent things at once with no clear priority is a textbook description of being overwhelmed.
quests.textToSpeak: The baby won't stop crying, the toddler just drew on the wall, and the phone has been ringing for ten minutes straight. I'm standing in the middle of the kitchen not sure which thing to deal with first.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A quiet, unplanned change in how someone refers to you reveals something they may never say directly.
quests.explanation: An unplanned, quiet acknowledgment of belonging, said almost by accident, is exactly what it means to be touched.
quests.textToSpeak: My father-in-law, who has never once used my name instead of 'son,' introduced me to his old friend as his son today. Just like that, mid-sentence.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Letting someone believe a convenient story instead of the real, less flattering reason points to an uncomfortable feeling.
quests.explanation: Letting someone believe a kinder story than the real, less flattering truth is a clear, quiet guilt.
quests.textToSpeak: I let my brother believe I forgot his call because I was busy. I saw it come in. I just didn't want to talk that night.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Repeating the same necessary information over and over with no system remembering it points to a stuck feeling.
quests.explanation: Having to repeat the same necessary information over and over, with nothing retained, is a clear frustration.
quests.textToSpeak: I've explained my condition to three different receptionists this month, and each one starts the intake process again from zero.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Wishing something for one reason while knowing the real cost falls on someone else you love points to a torn feeling.
quests.explanation: Wanting something for yourself while knowing the real cost lands on someone else you love is a genuine, difficult conflict.
quests.textToSpeak: Part of me wants her to fail, just this once, after everything. Most of me knows that if she does, it's my nephew who suffers for it, not her.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A shared word slipping back into the conversation, after months of avoiding it, points to a forward-looking feeling.
quests.explanation: A shared future starting to feel possible again, after a long difficult stretch, is a grounded form of hope.
quests.textToSpeak: The counselor said couples in far worse places than us have turned it around. It's the first time in months either of us has used the word 'us' about the future.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A small, ongoing dispute nobody ever actually resolves brings a familiar, low-level irritation.
quests.explanation: A small, ongoing dispute that never gets properly resolved is a very relatable, everyday annoyance.
quests.textToSpeak: The office thermostat has been fought over by the same two people for three years, and facilities still hasn't installed the second unit they promised in the first year.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Not having a ready answer to a simple, caring question, asked more than once, points to a flooded state.
quests.explanation: Not having a simple answer to a caring question, asked repeatedly, is a quiet sign of being overwhelmed.
quests.textToSpeak: Three separate people asked me today how I'm 'holding up,' and each time I realized I genuinely didn't know how to answer that.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Watching someone take on something difficult and new, entirely on their own terms, brings a quiet, warm feeling.
quests.explanation: Watching someone take on something new and difficult, entirely on their own, is a quiet, deep pride.
quests.textToSpeak: My mother, seventy-one and newly widowed, drove herself to the coast alone for the first time this month. She sent one photo. No caption.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A specific promise that shaped a real decision, later reversed without much acknowledgment, points to a deflated feeling.
quests.explanation: A specific promise that shaped a real decision, later quietly reversed, is a sharp, justified disappointment.
quests.textToSpeak: I turned down two other offers because this company promised remote work permanently. Eight months later, they've quietly changed the policy.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A child's imperfect but deeply intentional gesture, aimed at your specific pain, points to a quiet, deep feeling.
quests.explanation: A child's imperfect but deeply intentional gesture toward your specific grief is a tender cause of feeling touched.
quests.textToSpeak: My niece, who is four and doesn't fully understand what happened, drew me a picture of 'you and grandpa, so you're not lonely.' She got the ears wrong. I kept it anyway.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A promise phrased in absolute terms about something known to be unpredictable tends to raise doubt.
quests.explanation: A guarantee about something inherently unpredictable is a reasonable, well-founded skepticism.
quests.textToSpeak: The financial advisor keeps calling it a 'guaranteed return,' which is a phrase I remember someone telling me never actually exists in real investing.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Choosing to let real, unfinished problems wait, without anxiety about them, points to a calm, settled feeling.
quests.explanation: Letting real unfinished problems wait, without anxiety, for one quiet evening, reflects genuine contentment.
quests.textToSpeak: The renovation still isn't finished, the car needs new tires, and none of that felt urgent tonight, sitting on the back step with tea, watching the sky do very little.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A long-wanted milestone arriving tangled up with something bittersweet points to a mixed, specific feeling.
quests.explanation: A long-wanted milestone arriving tangled with something bittersweet, at the very same moment, is a genuine conflict of feeling.
quests.textToSpeak: I've wanted my own space for years. Signing the lease today, in the apartment my mother helped me choose, felt like both things happening in the same breath.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A group extending real patience, repeatedly, without you having to ask for it, points to a warm feeling.
quests.explanation: A group extending real, unasked-for patience toward your struggle is a clear cause of gratitude.
quests.textToSpeak: The whole rehearsal room stopped and waited, without a word of complaint, the four separate times I needed to restart the same sixteen bars.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Checking something already confirmed to be fine, again and again, points to a restless, ongoing feeling.
quests.explanation: Repeatedly checking something already known to be fine is a clear, familiar sign of anxiety.
quests.textToSpeak: Nothing on the itinerary has actually gone wrong yet. I've still checked the passport pocket four times since we left the house.
